title: Seed: Yoast meta
description: seed/yoast-meta.json → _yoast_wpseo_title / _yoast_wpseo_metadesc on the page/post the pages-map URL resolves to (starter_seed_import_yoast_meta). Patterns: docs/project/seo/meta-patterns.md.

url.description: Path from pages-map.json (or posts.json via its pages-map entry), e.g. / or /contacts/.

title.description: _yoast_wpseo_title. Empty/omitted leaves Yoast's own default (template or content title).
